nodes.label: DICConfirmationRequest schema
nodes.rationale: status_dic is not required when vendor status is NEED_CONFIRMATION because the backend auto-sets REQUEST_REVISION; reject_reason is required for DECLINED, REQUEST_REVISION and NEED_CONFIRMATION answers.
